job.style: a passage rich in numbers, dates or measurements

response.passage: At 4:15 AM, Ravi pulls his bicycle out of the narrow lane in Karol Bagh. The air is still cold as he pedals toward the distribution center to collect his daily stack of 142 newspapers. He has been doing this since 2019, a year before his father fell ill. Because the local printing press faced a sudden power outage, the bundles were delayed by thirty minutes today. Ravi sighs, knowing he must now cycle faster to reach the high-rise apartments of Vasant Vihar before the residents wake up. He navigates through the dark, empty streets, his headlight flickering against the damp walls. He avoids the main road because the heavy trucks make the path dangerous for his small cycle. He delivers the last paper at 7:30 AM, just as the sun begins to peek over the horizon. His legs ache from the extra effort, but he feels a sense of pride in his punctuality. He earns twelve rupees for every bundle delivered, which helps pay for his sister’s school books. He stops at a small stall for tea, watching the city slowly stir to life.
response.summary: Ravi is a dedicated newspaper delivery boy in Delhi who works hard to support his family. Despite delays caused by power issues, he ensures his deliveries are completed before the city wakes up.
